name: uv-auto-venv
description: Stop switching venvs manually. Auto-activates uv environments for standard projects with pyproject.toml and PEP-723 inline scripts the second you change tabs.

commands.title: UV Auto VEnv: Activate Virtual Environment

uv-auto-venv.showNotifications.description: Show a notification when the Python interpreter is changed.

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
